crossStoreReleaseYearContract.policy: A later Steam release year is neutral evidence, not a veto, only when the candidate is verified and already has exact normalized title, exact developer or publisher, compatible game type, clear margin, and no edition conflict.

focusedContracts: persistent 429 aborts after four total attempts and three bounded sleeps
numeric and HTTP-date Retry-After are honored with a 30-second cap
exhausted rate limiting emits only RATE_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED on stderr with nonzero CLI exit
minimal exact verified input without optional metadata remains REVIEW_REQUIRED
partial providers cannot auto-accept or emit unmatched
automatic acceptance correctness is reported separately
KOTOR cross-store year variance is neutral for established identity
multi-candidate ambiguity selects the unique closest release year at or before source year
Epic input accepts only a canonical product slug or canonical store.epicgames.com product URL
Epic CMS enforces a 1 MiB JSON body, unique productHome, namespace/title/offer identity, and validated HTTPS media
Epic fallback triggers only after complete nonpartial Steam UNMATCHED with no plausible candidate
partial/review/provider-failure/malformed/rate-limited Steam outcomes never trigger Epic fallback
derived Epic slug 404 emits typed SLUG_REQUIRED
persistent Epic CMS 429 emits only typed RATE_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED
Alan Wake 2 stale Coming Soon release label produces null date/year and preserves a warning
